title: Matte Gray 3-Tier Wall Mount Towel Shelf With Drying Rack, 24.7-Inch Hotel-Style Brass Bathroom Storage, Allied Brass
body_html:
Make your bathroom feel organized and spacious by moving towel storage off the counter and onto the wall in Matte Gray, which provides a sophisticated neutral that complements concrete, stone, and other modern materials. This traditional, hotel-style towel shelf combines folded-towel storage with a built-in drying rack, and it’s backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty.

  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Store more: three-tier shelf layout for towels and linens
  • Dry efficiently: integrated rack-style arms keep towels ready for use
  • Clean install: concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Design flexibility: available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes

Specs

  • Overall dimensions: 24.7 in L x 10.4 in H x 8.9 in W
  • Projection: 3.5 in
  • Material: brass
  • Mounting: wall mount
  • Assembly: some assembly required
  • Included: towel shelf arms (3), back plate, and all installation hardware
  • Product weight: 5.6 lb (shipping weight: 7 lb)
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
